name: HaloShop_Bakery
note: Shop (24 x 15 x 18). Rect body 20 x 13.5, a 9.5-stud ground storey: ONE big arched shop window on the viewer's left (shopwin u 0.26) and the door at the right (door.u 0.75) as in the 2D, a short upper tier with the small arched window over the sign, gold corner pilasters, one lantern pedestal (the other has no room), wide blue/white awning over the whole front (awning.u 0.5), two corner planters with topiary, flat roof with a solid parapet. Missing: gold sign plaque, raised arched gable with the round-top window, brick-red dome + chimney lantern tower, baker's display shelves, ivy on the corner posts (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloShop_Bakery_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG is not in the worktree.
